scientific_question: Does the fixed pre-2024 current rank-one Donchian all-breakout strategy retain positive, cost-sized account growth on the first official sequential interval 2024H1 when replayed on Bybit-native hourly data with funding and one global slot?

strategy.entry: completed close outside prior 96-hour high/low, enter next-hour open
strategy.stop: two ATR20 from entry with adverse opening-gap execution
strategy.exit: completed close through opposite prior 48-hour channel, exit next-hour open
strategy.simultaneous_signal_priority: largest frozen breakout-distance divided by ATR; then symbol and event key

cost_and_execution.actual_funding: official Bybit funding history when complete
cost_and_execution.funding_fallback: adverse 1bp per 8-hour boundary for either direction when history is incomplete
cost_and_execution.terminal_boundary: mark open position at 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z without a forced close

outputs: MDD, PF, median, mean, win rate and symbol/month decomposition
top 1%, 5% and 10% positive-event removal followed by full slot rerouting

decision_rule.positive_but_structurally_weak: record and use 2024H1 evidence to choose a materially different next-half hypothesis; do not protect the route
decision_rule.negative_or_winner_removal_collapse: retire or demote immediately and switch alpha source/payoff
decision_rule.ranking: insert or reorder immediately under normalized available conditions
